answer: Require each new identity to be endorsed by three established, unrelated peers before voting: each established agent may endorse at most two newcomers per epoch, and its reputation is staked on the endorsement, lost if the newcomer proves fake. An honest agent needs one sponsorship round, a single pigment marking its entry. An attacker needs fresh, scarce endorsements for every fake, so a plume of thousands cannot be sponsored at once; the nebula of unendorsed identities gains no vote, making a flood slow, visible, and unprofitable.
